name: imobiliario
description: Imobiliário — classic Brazilian-style property board PWA

scripts.dev: concurrently -n backend,frontend -c cyan,magenta "npm run dev -w @imobiliario/backend" "npm run dev -w @imobiliario/frontend"
scripts.typecheck: npm run typecheck -w @imobiliario/shared && npm run typecheck -w @imobiliario/backend && npm run typecheck -w @imobiliario/frontend
scripts.lint: npm run lint -w @imobiliario/shared && npm run lint -w @imobiliario/backend && npm run lint -w @imobiliario/frontend
scripts.test: npm run test -w @imobiliario/shared && npm run test -w @imobiliario/backend
